svg.title: Where will a book take you? — wide reading invitation
svg.desc: Copy occupies a dark left column, while an intact landscape panel on the right keeps the travelers, stream and sunlit destination together. Artwork by David Revoy, Pepper and Carrot episode 26 page 1, CC BY 4.0. New composition by Charter; not an original comic page or an endorsed campaign.
svg.metadata: Source: https://www.peppercarrot.com/en/webcomic-sources/ep26_Books-Are-Great.html | Artwork: David Revoy | License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ | Derivative changes: first-panel extraction, uniform scaling, new typography and background; the square composition becomes separate copy and picture columns. Original JPEG remains unchanged beside this SVG. Full credits: README.md.
